_comment: Parameters > Add parameter: the name, then the value -- and, for a vector, its populations and the column that picks them (Qt: two QInputDialogs).

sections.label: Parameter name:
sections.description: Name of the new overlay parameter.

sections.label: {value_label}
sections.description: Initial value of the new overlay parameter.

sections.label: Kind:
sections.description: Scalar: one value for all bursts. Vector: one value per population.
descriptions: One value shared by all bursts.
One value per population, picked by a column of the burst table.

sections.label: Populations:
sections.description: How many (3: populations 0, 1, 2), or their names (HF, LF).

sections.label: Picked by:
sections.description: The burst column whose value says which population a burst is in.

buttons.label: OK
buttons.description: Accept the entries and close the dialog.

buttons.label: Cancel
buttons.description: Discard the changes and close the dialog.
